answer_1.quote: we propose table-to-report, a novel task designed to convert structured tabular data into natural language reports

answer_2.quote: We develop an evaluation system that incorporates three criteria of numerical accuracy, information coverage, and general quality to comprehensively assess report quality

answer_3.quote: Inspired by evaluation methodologies for long-context generation, we propose the General Evaluation Criterion (GEC) to holistically assess report quality using LLMs as judges

answer_4.quote: Another six independent annotators evaluated reports generated by five representative models... achieving excellent interrater reliability (Fleiss' k = 0.85)
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluated reports using the same criteria as automatic metrics (NAC, ICC, GEC)
